$comment: Deterministic per-step ceilings, measured on the committed synthetic fixture (npm run perf:fixture; 3 runs, identical across two sessions, 7 Oct 2026). Lowered as #999 stories land: a story that lowers a number lowers it here in the same change; see README.md. The boot-bundle gzip budget is NOT here: it lives in bootBudgetPlugin (vite.config.ts). Raised on purpose in #999 2.2: the dashboard no longer preloads the NPC and encounter lists (it reads counts), so /npcs and /encounters fetch their own slim lists on navigation. 9 Oct 2026 (#999 2.14/2.15): set from main's CI run on be36371c. totalRequests added (it counts code chunks too, so a fragmenting chunk graph shows here). apiRequests: the global search no longer reads the two enabled-sources tables before a search (2.15), get_unembedded_content_counts is gone, and #848 added two Edge Function calls (embed-content and embed-monsters, mode audit) to every dashboard load and resume; CI counts two more than a laptop does for those. serialDepth is not as deterministic as the fixture promised: main's history flaps dm-cold 4/5 and dm-warm 5/6, so those ceilings are the observed maximum, not one run.
